title: accordion find in page misses collapsed
rule: Accordion: hidden copy is invisible to Find in page — browsers’ find does not match collapsed accordion text. Dual-cite USWDS “use only if users need a few pieces”; this names the find-in-page failure.
pass_when: Content people must find with Find in page is not only inside a collapsed accordion.
fail_when: Essential copy lives only in collapsed accordion panels (Find in page cannot match it).
overview: Content people must find with Find in page is not only inside a collapsed accordion.
not_when: Not for the destructive decision inside a dialog.
